mission.title: Retake Platforms From Nine Tails
mission.description:
Glad to have you undertaking this operation for Northrock. Here is the full brief:

Your priority is to <EM4>disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters</EM4> that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.

Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces. 

Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission. 

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
